verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable workflow automation platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, diagnostics, usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. Self-hosting on your own infrastructure is a different capability and earns no credit toward a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
